title: A Review of the Bridge Program: How One School Shared Its Resources
instructions: 这是为成人英语学习者编写的原创模拟阅读材料（非官方雅思试题，也不代表任何真实学校或研究）。请先通读文章，理解大意；然后完成10道阅读题（单选、填空、匹配、判断正误/未提及）。所有题目和选项均为英文，解释为中文。语法部分先学习“条件句、数量词、段落间的指代与衔接”的新规则，再完成8道独立新句子的语法题。最后进行口语和写作迁移练习。建议用时：阅读15分钟，语法10分钟，口语/写作各10分钟。
passage:
A Review of the Bridge Program: How One School Shared Its Resources

[A] Last September, Westfield Community School started a small education program called the Bridge Program. The program was for students who needed extra help with reading and maths. The school had a limited budget, so the head teacher, Ms. Chen, had to decide how to use the money and the teachers' time. She wanted to help as many students as possible without making classes larger for everyone else. This is a review of what the school did, what worked, and what did not.

[B] First, the school checked the needs of each class. Teachers filled in a short form about every student who was below the expected level in reading or maths. The forms showed that 48 students needed help. However, the school could only pay for two extra teachers. Ms. Chen decided to use a “small group” plan. Each extra teacher worked with groups of six students for 30 minutes, four times a week. The groups met in the library, so the normal classrooms did not become crowded. The school also bought 60 new reading books and 20 maths workbooks. These resources were shared among all the groups.

[C] After ten weeks, the school did a stage check. The check had three parts: a reading test, a maths test, and a short interview with each student. The results were mixed. In reading, 32 of the 48 students moved up one level. In maths, only 19 students moved up. The interview notes showed that many students liked the small groups because they could ask questions more easily. However, some students said they felt “different” when they left their normal class. Also, the two extra teachers were very tired because they taught many groups every day.

[D] The school made three changes for the next ten weeks. First, it moved the group lessons to the morning, when students were more awake. Second, it asked two classroom teachers to join the small groups for one session a week. This gave the extra teachers a short break and helped the classroom teachers understand the students' problems. Third, the school started a “reading buddy” plan: stronger readers read with weaker readers for 15 minutes, twice a week. The school did not buy any new materials for this plan; it used the books it already had.

[E] At the end of the second stage, the school checked again. This time, 41 students moved up in reading, and 33 moved up in maths. The interview notes were also better: fewer students said they felt “different”, and more students said they enjoyed the morning lessons. The head teacher was pleased, but she said the program still had a problem: the school could not help every student who needed it. Next year, she hopes to find more money for a third extra teacher. If the school gets more money, it will also buy more books for the reading buddy plan.

[F] In conclusion, the Bridge Program shows that a school can use limited resources in a better way. Small groups, morning lessons, and reading buddies all helped. However, the program also shows that stage checks are important: they help teachers see what is working and what is not. Without the checks, the school might not have changed the timetable or started the buddy plan. The school will continue the program next year and will review it again in December.

questions.prompt: How many students needed extra help at the start?
questions.explanation: 文章[B]段明确说“The forms showed that 48 students needed help.”，所以答案是48名学生。
questions.evidence: The forms showed that 48 students needed help.

questions.prompt: How long did each small group lesson last?
questions.explanation: 文章[B]段说“Each extra teacher worked with groups of six students for 30 minutes”，因此每次小组课30分钟。
questions.evidence: Each extra teacher worked with groups of six students for 30 minutes, four times a week.

questions.prompt: What is the main idea of paragraph [C]?
options: The first stage check showed mixed results.
The school bought new books for the library.
The head teacher changed the timetable.
The reading buddy plan started in September.
answers: The first stage check showed mixed results.
questions.explanation: [C]段主要讲十周后的阶段检查结果有好有坏（阅读进步32人，数学进步19人，学生感受不同），因此主旨是“第一次阶段检查结果好坏参半”。

questions.prompt: Which change was made for the second ten weeks?
options: Group lessons moved to the morning.
The school bought 60 new reading books.
The school hired a third extra teacher.
The library was closed for repairs.
answers: Group lessons moved to the morning.
questions.explanation: [D]段第一条变化是“it moved the group lessons to the morning”，即小组课改到上午。其他选项要么是之前的事，要么是明年才希望做的事。
questions.evidence: First, it moved the group lessons to the morning, when students were more awake.

questions.prompt: At the end of the second stage, how many students moved up in reading? Write the number and the word 'students'.
questions.explanation: [E]段说“41 students moved up in reading”，所以填“41 students”。
questions.evidence: This time, 41 students moved up in reading, and 33 moved up in maths.

questions.prompt: What did the school use for the reading buddy plan? Write FOUR WORDS from the text.
questions.explanation: 原文说“it used the books it already had”。答案books / it / already / had共四词，表示学校已经拥有的书；词数要求不包括原文the，因为答案本身已是完整的复数名词短语。
questions.evidence: The school did not buy any new materials for this plan; it used the books it already had.

questions.prompt: True, False, or Not Given: The classroom teachers joined the small groups every day during the second stage.
questions.explanation: 原文规定两位课堂教师每周加入一节小组课，而题目说every day（每天），频率直接矛盾，所以是False。不能把最初额外教师每周四次的小组课安排混到课堂教师后来每周一次的安排里。
questions.evidence: Second, it asked two classroom teachers to join the small groups for one session a week.

questions.prompt: True, False, or Not Given: The head teacher wants to find more money for a third extra teacher next year.
questions.explanation: [E]段说“Next year, she hopes to find more money for a third extra teacher.”，与题目一致，因此是True。
questions.evidence: Next year, she hopes to find more money for a third extra teacher.

questions.prompt: True, False, or Not Given: The school will review the program again in December.
questions.explanation: [F]段最后一句说“The school will continue the program next year and will review it again in December.”，因此是True。
questions.evidence: The school will continue the program next year and will review it again in December.

questions.prompt: True, False, or Not Given: The two extra teachers received more money for the second stage.
questions.explanation: 原文只提到额外老师很累、后来有课堂老师加入让他们短暂休息，但完全没有提到是否加薪。这个信息在文中缺失，因此是Not Given。
questions.evidence: This gave the extra teachers a short break and helped the classroom teachers understand the students' problems.
questions.evidenceScope: Context quote only; absence of salary information checked across the entire passage.

These resources were shared among all the groups.
After ten weeks, the school did a stage check.
Without the checks, the school might not have changed the timetable or started the buddy plan.
Second, it asked two classroom teachers to join the small groups for one session a week.

grammar.title: 条件句、数量词、段落间的指代与衔接
grammar.explanation: 本课重点有三：1）条件句：表示“如果……就……”。真实可能发生用“if + 一般现在时，主句用 will/can + 动词原形”，例如“If the school gets more money, it will buy more books.”；谈现在或未来的想象、较不可能的情况，或与现实相反的情况，用“if + 过去式，主句用 would/could + 动词原形”，例如“If I had more time, I would join the group.”。2）数量词：可数名词用 many/few/a few，不可数名词用 much/little/a little；a lot of 两者皆可。3）段落间的指代与衔接：用 this/these/that/it/they 指代前文内容，用 however/therefore/also/first/second 等连接词使段落连贯。注意：本课新学“if 条件句（真实与虚拟）”，复习“数量词”和“指代衔接”。
grammar.example: If the school gets more money, it will also buy more books for the reading buddy plan.

questions.prompt: 按第一条件句的if从句“一般现在时”形式选择：If it ______ tomorrow, we will stay at home.
questions.explanation: 题目明确要求if从句采用一般现在时，it为第三人称单数，因此选rains。is raining也可以出现在谈未来的条件句中，但它是现在进行时，不是本题指定的形式；不能笼统说它在所有条件句里都错误。
questions.evidence: If the school gets more money, it will also buy more books for the reading buddy plan.

questions.prompt: If I ______ more free time, I would join the reading club.
questions.explanation: 主句would join把情境设为现在或未来的假设，if从句用过去式had。此句是独立语法例句，不是声称源文人物缺少空闲时间。
questions.evidence: If I had more free time, I would join the reading club.

questions.prompt: There are ______ students in the small group, but only ______ time for questions.
questions.explanation: students 是可数名词复数，用 many；time 是不可数名词，用 little。因此选 many; little。
questions.evidence: Each extra teacher worked with groups of six students for 30 minutes, four times a week.

questions.prompt: The school bought 60 new reading books. ______ were shared among all the groups.
questions.explanation: 前文提到 60 new reading books 是复数，指代它们用 They。
questions.evidence: The school also bought 60 new reading books and 20 maths workbooks. These resources were shared among all the groups.

questions.prompt: 用表示结果“因此”的连接词：The printer is broken. ______, we will send the worksheets by email.
questions.explanation: 这是独立的新语境例句。题目指定用“因此”表达前因后果，Therefore符合；However和In contrast表转折，For example引出例子，都不表达题目要求的结果关系。
questions.evidence: The printer is broken. Therefore, we will send the worksheets by email.

questions.prompt: If the teachers ______ more help, the students would learn faster.
questions.explanation: 这是想象获得更多帮助后的情形：主句用would learn，if从句用过去式got。它表达假设，并不要求先证明现实一定相反。
questions.evidence: If the teachers got more help, the students would learn faster.

questions.prompt: We have ______ money this year, so we can only buy ______ books.
questions.explanation: money 不可数，用 little；books 可数复数，用 a few。因此选 little; a few。
questions.evidence: The school had a limited budget, so the head teacher, Ms. Chen, had to decide how to use the money and the teachers' time.

questions.prompt: The reading buddy plan used old books. ______, it did not cost much money.
questions.explanation: 前后是结果关系：因为使用旧书，所以花费不多。As a result 表示“结果”。
questions.evidence: The school did not buy any new materials for this plan; it used the books it already had.
